description: Wind Potentials Breakout Group Report is a data resource listed in openmod Initiative wiki, a community wiki of open energy models and data under the section "Wind geographical potentials", published or maintained by docs.google.com (publisher inferred from the link). This page grew out of the Wind Potentials Breakout Group Report from the Open Energy Modelling Workshop - London 2015. Coverage: as stated on the linked page. The openmod wiki page "Wind geographical potentials" lists it. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the wiki page (source page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wind potential inputs to energy-system models. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-openmod-initiative-wiki.
